          \\\n    PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1\n\nWORKDIR /app\n\n# System deps:\n#   - ca-certificates:

          (see backend/claude-config/README.md).\nRUN install -d -m 0755 /etc/apt/keyrings \\\n && apt-get
          update \\\n && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl gnupg \\\n &&
          curl -fsSL https://downloads.claude.ai/keys/claude-code.asc \\\n      -o /etc/apt/keyrings/claude-code.asc
          \\\n && echo \"deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/claude-code.asc] https://downloads.claude.ai/claude-code/apt/stable
          stable main\" \\\n      > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/claude-code.list \\\n && apt-get update \\\

          \n# Source must exist before `pip install -e` so the editable finder picks up\n# the anvil package
          mapping. Tests masked this via pythonpath=\".\" but the CLI\n# (installed at /usr/local/bin/anvil)
          breaks outside /app without it.\nCOPY pyproject.toml ./\nCOPY anvil ./anvil\nRUN pip install
          -e \".[dev]\"\n\nCOPY tests ./tests\nCOPY alembic ./alembic\nCOPY alembic.ini ./alembic.ini\n\
          \n# Claude CLI config (OAuth credentials + settings.json) is baked in at the\n# very end so
          editing it rebuilds only this layer + below — earlier layers\n# (apt, pip install, source) stay
          cached. See backend/claude-config/README.md\n# for what goes here and when a rebuild is needed
          (OAuth rotation, re-auth on\n# host, settings tweak). The previous bind-mount of ~/.claude was
          clobbering\n# the host config because the container runs as root.\nCOPY claude-config /root/.claude\n\
          RUN chmod 700 /root/.claude \\\n && find /root/.claude -type f -exec chmod 600 {} \\;\n\nEXPOSE
